content:
Apple TV subscribers can now watch the entire latest season of *Stillwater*, the platform's award-winning, mindfulness-themed animated series. See the trailer below.

All five episodes are now streaming

Days after unveiling the trailer for the new season of *Stillwater*, Apple TV today made all five episodes of the Emmy Award-winning, Zen-inspired series available for streaming.

*Stillwater* is based on Jon J Muth's bestselling "Zen" picture book series published by Scholastic. The original series premiered in 2020 and has won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Children's Animated Program, as well as a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth category.

Season 4 of *Stillwater* premiered last August, ending a two-year hiatus since Season 3. For more on the show, here's the synopsis from Apple TV:
